Grade % academic instruction in Spanish Kindergarten 80% First 80% Second 80% Third 60% Fourth 60% Typical day Students in the Spanish Immersion (K-4) learn in a typical class with one teacher in charge of all core academic areas. The class receives English instruction while attending daily unified arts classes (Physical Education, Art, Spanish, Music, Guidance, Library) .
